claim: The maximum air temperature in Helsinki on 2026-08-26 (UTC day) will be above 19.4°C.
resolution_criterion: YES if the value at JSON pointer /daily/temperature_2m_max/0 in the Open-Meteo response for latitude 60.17, longitude 24.94, start_date=2026-08-26, end_date=2026-08-26, timezone=UTC is strictly greater than 19.4. NO otherwise. The threshold was set to the forecast value published for 2026-08-26 at the time of writing, so the honest probability is close to a half. This is a canary: it is unscored and exists to exercise the pipeline daily.
